observations: Torah #8 yields 4 packages that map cleanly onto the Torah's own four-part structure: (1) רוח חיים — the holy breath-of-life and all its parallel expressions (the dominant cluster of 27 nodes); (2) תפלה — prayer as potential creation, including wisdom-as-spring and the Eden-dimension; (3) תורה — Torah as actual creation, with its spirit-of-40-days and the garden metaphor; (4) עשו / רוח הטמאה — the evil mirror of the holy ruach-chaim, consisting of Esav, his commanders (אלופי עשו, רב דקלפה), his storm-wind (רוח סערה), and his evil red garment (טלית דקלפה = טלית אדום). The structure is: 'Draw ruach-chaim through sighing [Pkg 1] ← from Torah [Pkg 3] ← awakened by prayer [Pkg 2] → thereby subduing Esav's storm-wind [Pkg 4].' This structure is complete and self-contained. No bechina-connected cluster of concepts in the source text is left unaccounted for that would warrant a new package. The orphaned concepts noted in torah_8_additions.json (נשימה, צדיק, ארבעה יסודות, etc.) are candidate nodes for future bechina-edge enrichment of the existing packages — they would be absorbed into existing packages (primarily Package 1) and do not form an independent thematic cluster requiring a new package.
